The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Regarding the competitor's strategy, Brand X is employing an aggressive penetration pricing model combined with targeted digital marketing. By absorbing short-term losses to undercut prices and capture market share, they aim to build long-term customer loyalty. Their focus on a younger demographic through increased online and social media presence suggests an attempt to shift consumer perceptions and buying patterns. This strategy poses a significant threat to our business, as it could directly impact our sales figures by drawing away price-sensitive and younger customers. We may need to respond with competitive pricing, enhanced digital engagement, or value-added propositions to retain our market position.
